"};
const art={}; let loaded=0; for(const [k,v] of Object.entries(assetURIs)){const img=new Image();img.onload=()=>loaded++;img.src=v;art[k]=img;}

const modes=['ARCADE · 12 FIGHTS','VERSUS CPU','VERSUS · TWO CONTROLLERS','WATCH · CPU VS CPU'];
let pads=[],edges=[{},{}],noPad='CONNECT XBOX OR LOGITECH CONTROLLER',cooldowns=[0,0];

function copyColor(h){return h||'#e8b75b'}
function text(str,x,y,size=26,color='#f8e2b9',align='center',outline=4){ctx.save();ctx.textAlign=align;ctx.textBaseline='middle';ctx.font=`bold ${size}px Georgia,serif`;ctx.strokeStyle='#0b0616';ctx.lineJoin='round';ctx.lineWidth=outline;ctx.strokeText(str,x,y);ctx.fillStyle=color;ctx.fillText(str,x,y);ctx.restore();}

function pollPads(){try{pads=[...(navigator.getGamepads?.()||[])].filter(p=>p&&p.connected);}catch(e){pads=[];}noPad=pads.length?pads.map((p,i)=>`PAD ${i+1}: ${p.id.slice(0,30)}`).join(' · '):'CONNECT XBOX OR LOGITECH CONTROLLER';}
function padInput(i){let p=pads[i],prev=edges[i]||{},b={};for(let j=0;j<17;j++)b[j]=!!p?.buttons?.[j]?.pressed;
 const ax=p?.axes?.[0]||0,ay=p?.axes?.[1]||0;
 const held=j=>!!b[j],tap=j=>!!b[j]&&!prev[j];
 const left=held(14)||ax<-.42,right=held(15)||ax>.42,up=held(12)||ay<-.53,down=held(13)||ay>.53;
 const res={walk:(right?1:0)-(left?1:0),crouch:down,jump:tap(0),kick:tap(1),palm:tap(2),heavy:tap(3),power1:tap(4),power2:tap(5),guard:held(6)||held(7),pause:tap(9),back:tap(8),
 leftTap:(left&&!prev.left),rightTap:(right&&!prev.right),upTap:(up&&!prev.up),downTap:(down&&!prev.down),ok:tap(0),cancel:tap(1)};
 edges[i]={...b,left,right,up,down};return res;}
const neutral={walk:0,crouch:false,jump:false,kick:false,palm:false,heavy:false,power1:false,power2:false,guard:false,pause:false,back:false,leftTap:false,rightTap:false,upTap:false,downTap:false,ok:false,cancel:false};
function player(spec,x,side,controller){return {spec,x,y:0,vy:0,dx:0,side,controller,hp:1000,atk:null,atkTime:0,atkHit:false,attackRecovery:0,stun:0,knock:0,knockElapsed:0,guard:false,crouch:false,anim:'idle',walkTimer:0,breathSeed:Math.random()*4,combo:0,comboTimer:0,display:''};}
// Every goddess shares the same attack data. Character-specific frames alter presentation only.
const attacks={
 palm:{dur:.32,wind:.10,act:.12,damage:40,range:122,push:18,label:'PALM',height:'mid'},
 kick:{dur:.46,wind:.16,act:.14,damage:67,range:175,push:28,label:'KICK',height:'mid'},
 heavy:{dur:.64,wind:.24,act:.17,damage:95,range:198,push:42,label:'STRONG KICK',height:'mid'},
 power1:{dur:.75,wind:.25,act:.24,damage:112,range:228,push:48,label:'DIVINE POWER',height:'mid'},
 power2:{dur:.90,wind:.33,act:.26,damage:137,range:250,push:54,label:'DIVINE POWER',height:'mid'},
 crouchPalm:{dur:.35,wind:.12,act:.12,damage:40,range:135,push:18,label:'CROUCH PALM',height:'low'},
 crouchKick:{dur:.49,wind:.17,act:.15,damage:67,range:190,push:28,label:'LOW SWEEP',height:'low'},
 crouchHeavy:{dur:.66,wind:.25,act:.18,damage:95,range:205,push:42,label:'LOW STRONG KICK',height:'low'},
 airPalm:{dur:.34,wind:.09,act:.12,damage:40,range:142,push:18,label:'AIR PALM',height:'air'},
 airKick:{dur:.46,wind:.13,act:.15,damage:67,range:190,push:28,label:'FLYING KICK',height:'air'},
 airHeavy:{dur:.60,wind:.18,act:.18,damage:95,range:206,push:42,label:'FLYING STRONG KICK',height:'air'}

function addCall(txt,x,y,color='#f6d992',time=.9){callouts.push({txt,x,y,color,t:time,max:time});}
function fx(x,y,color,n=14,r=40){effects.push({x,y,color,n,r,t:.42,max:.42});}
function startMatch(){pause=false;roundTime=99;effects=[];callouts=[];const m=modeIndex;
 let p1=roster[cursor],opp=m===MODE_ARCADE?roster[(cursor+round)%roster.length]:(m===MODE_VS_P2||m===MODE_WATCH)?roster[p2cursor]:roster[(cursor+3)%roster.length];
 if(m===MODE_ARCADE && opp.id===p1.id)opp=roster[(cursor+round+1)%roster.length];
 activeStage=roster.indexOf(opp);
 fighters=[player(p1,380,1,m===MODE_WATCH?-1:0),player(opp,900,-1,m===MODE_VS_P2?1:-1)];
 screen='fight';result='';sound(240,.11);}
function nextArcade(){round++;if(round>12){screen='complete';return;}startMatch();}
function begin(){if(modeIndex===MODE_VS_P2&&pads.length<2){addCall('TWO GAMEPADS REQUIRED',W/2,640,'#ffabab',1.8);return;}
 if(modeIndex===MODE_VS_P2||modeIndex===MODE_WATCH){selectionPhase=2;screen='roster';return;}
 round=1;runGold=0;winStreak=0;startMatch();}
function cpuInput(me,opp,dt,slot){if(me.knock||me.stun||me.atk)return neutral;
 cooldowns[slot]=Math.max(0,cooldowns[slot]-dt);let dist=Math.abs(opp.x-me.x),dir=opp.x>me.x?1:-1;
 let o={...neutral,walk:dist>160?dir:dist<85?-dir:0};
 if(cooldowns[slot]===0){cooldowns[slot]=rng(.28,.74);const r=Math.random();if(dist<245){if(r<.20)o.palm=true;else if(r<.41)o.kick=true;else if(r<.54)o.heavy=true;else if(r<.67)o.power1=true;else if(r<.73)o.power2=true;else if(r<.82)o.crouch=true;else if(r<.89)o.guard=true;else if(r<.92)o.jump=true;}else if(r<.16)o.jump=true;}
 return o;}
function finishCombo(f){if(!f.combo)return;const amt=[0,300,900,1100][Math.min(f.combo,3)];
 if(f.controller===0 || (f.controller===1&&modeIndex===MODE_VS_P2)){runGold+=amt;addCall(`${f.combo} HIT${f.combo===1?'':'S'} · +${amt.toLocaleString()} GOLD`,f.x,188,'#f7d17f',1.2);}f.combo=0;f.comboTimer=0;}
function startAttack(f,type){if(f.atk||f.stun||f.knock||f.attackRecovery>0)return;
 f.atk=type;f.atkTime=0;f.atkHit=false;f.guard=false;f.crouch=attacks[type].height==='low';f.anim=type;sound(type.startsWith('power')?520:260,.07,.05);}
function doHit(att,def){let m=attacks[att.atk];if(att.atkHit)return;att.atkHit=true;let dx=(def.x-att.x)*att.side,dist=Math.abs(def.x-att.x);
 if(dx<0||dist>m.range+30||def.knock>0)return;
 // Crouch sweeps pass under airborne opponents; air blows need an opponent at reachable height.
 if(m.height==='low'&&def.y< -65)return;
 if(m.height==='air'&&Math.abs(att.y-def.y)>185)return;
 if(m.height==='mid'&&def.y< -185)return;
 if(def.guard){fx(def.x,GROUND-126,'#8bddff',7,25);def.stun=.09;addCall('BLOCK',def.x,GROUND-260,'#a4ebff',.45);return;}
 const damage=m.damage;def.hp=Math.max(0,def.hp-damage);def.stun=.23;def.anim='hurt';def.x=cap(def.x+att.side*m.push,120,1160);
 if(att.comboTimer<=0)finishCombo(att);att.combo=Math.min(3,att.combo+1);att.comboTimer=1.10;
 let c=att.spec.accent;if(att.atk==='power1'||att.atk==='power2'){
  c=att.atk==='power1'?att.spec.accent:'#f2d899';
  addCall(att.atk==='power1'?att.spec.power1.toUpperCase():att.spec.power2.toUpperCase(),(att.x+def.x)/2,GROUND-330,c,1.05);
 }
 fx(def.x,GROUND-(m.height==='low'?85:m.height==='air'?220:180),c,att.atk.startsWith('power')?18:10,att.atk.startsWith('power')?80:44);
 addCall(`${damage} DAMAGE`,def.x,GROUND-278,'#fff0c0',.55);sound(90,.14,.13);
 if(att.combo===3){def.knock=1.36;def.knockElapsed=0;def.stun=0;def.vy=-215;def.y=-2;def.dx=att.side*90;def.anim='down';addCall('THREE-HIT KNOCKDOWN!',(att.x+def.x)/2,GROUND-370,'#ffdb83',1.1);finishCombo(att);}
 if(def.hp<=0){def.hp=0;finishCombo(att);endMatch(att);}
}
function endMatch(winner){if(screen!=='fight')return;for(const f of fighters)finishCombo(f);
 const a=fighters[0],b=fighters[1];result=winner?winner.spec.name+' WINS':a.hp===b.hp?'DRAW':a.hp>b.hp?a.spec.name+' WINS':b.spec.name+' WINS';
 const playerWon=winner===a||(!winner&&a.hp>b.hp);
 if(modeIndex===MODE_ARCADE && playerWon){winStreak++;screen='intermission';}else screen='result';sound(350,.15,.06);}
function updateFighter(f,opp,inp,dt){
 f.side=opp.x>=f.x?1:-1;
 if(f.comboTimer>0){f.comboTimer-=dt;if(f.comboTimer<=0)finishCombo(f);}
 f.stun=Math.max(0,f.stun-dt);f.attackRecovery=Math.max(0,f.attackRecovery-dt);
 if(f.knock>0){f.knock-=dt;f.knockElapsed+=dt;f.x=cap(f.x+f.dx*dt,80,1200);f.dx*=.97;f.vy+=900*dt;f.y=Math.min(0,f.y+f.vy*dt);if(f.y>=0)f.vy=0;f.anim='down';f.crouch=true; if(f.knock<=0) {f.anim='idle';f.crouch=false;}return;}
 if(f.stun>0){f.anim='hurt';return;}
 if(f.atk){const m=attacks[f.atk];
  f.atkTime+=dt;f.anim=f.atk;f.crouch=m.height==='low';
  // Air attacks preserve jump gravity and horizontal momentum rather than freezing in space.
  if(f.y<0||f.vy<0){f.vy+=1000*dt;f.y=Math.min(0,f.y+f.vy*dt);f.x=cap(f.x+(inp.walk||0)*130*dt,85,1195);if(f.y===0)f.vy=0;}

 if(f.y<0||f.vy<0){
  if(f.attackRecovery<=0){if(inp.heavy){startAttack(f,'airHeavy');return;}if(inp.kick){startAttack(f,'airKick');return;}if(inp.palm){startAttack(f,'airPalm');return;}}
  f.vy+=1000*dt;f.y=Math.min(0,f.y+f.vy*dt);f.x=cap(f.x+(inp.walk||0)*180*dt,85,1195);f.anim='jump';f.crouch=false;
  if(f.y===0){f.vy=0;f.anim='land';f.attackRecovery=.11;}return;}
 if(inp.jump){f.vy=-475;f.y=-3;f.anim='jump';f.crouch=false;sound(410,.06,.04);return;}
 if(f.attackRecovery<=0){for(const k of ['power2','power1','heavy','kick','palm'])if(inp[k]){

}
function update(dt){clock+=dt;pollPads();const a=pads.length?padInput(0):neutral,b=pads.length>1?padInput(1):neutral;
 for(const f of effects)f.t-=dt;effects=effects.filter(f=>f.t>0);
 for(const f of callouts){f.t-=dt;f.y-=12*dt;}callouts=callouts.filter(f=>f.t>0);
 if(screen==='title'){if(a.ok||b.ok){screen='roster';selectionPhase=1;sound(400,.09);}return;}
 if(screen==='roster'){
  const inp=selectionPhase===2&&modeIndex===MODE_VS_P2?b:a;
  if(a.power1&&selectionPhase===1)modeIndex=(modeIndex+3)%4;
  if(a.power2&&selectionPhase===1)modeIndex=(modeIndex+1)%4;
  let here=selectionPhase===1?cursor:p2cursor;
  if(inp.leftTap)here=(here+11)%12;if(inp.rightTap)here=(here+1)%12;
  if(inp.upTap)here=(here+8)%12;if(inp.downTap)here=(here+4)%12;
  if(selectionPhase===1)cursor=here;else p2cursor=here;
  if(inp.ok){if(selectionPhase===1)begin();else{round=1;runGold=0;startMatch();}}
  if(inp.cancel||inp.back){if(selectionPhase===2)selectionPhase=1;else screen='title';}return;
 }
 if(screen==='result'){if(a.ok||b.ok){round=1;runGold=0;startMatch();}else if(a.palm||a.back){screen='roster';selectionPhase=1;}return;}
 if(screen==='intermission'){if(a.ok||b.ok){if(round===12){screen='complete';}else nextArcade();}else if(a.back){screen='roster';selectionPhase=1;}return;}
 if(screen==='complete'){if(a.ok||a.back){screen='roster';selectionPhase=1;}return;}
 if(screen!=='fight')return;
 if(a.pause||b.pause){pause=!pause;sound(300,.06);}if(pause)return;
 let i0=fighters[0].controller===0?a:cpuInput(fighters[0],fighters[1],dt,0);
 let i1=fighters[1].controller===1?b:cpuInput(fighters[1],fighters[0],dt,1);
 updateFighter(fighters[0],fighters[1],i0,dt);
 if(screen==='fight')updateFighter(fighters[1],fighters[0],i1,dt);
 if(screen==='fight'){roundTime-=dt;if(roundTime<=0)endMatch(fighters[0].hp===fighters[1].hp?null:fighters[0].hp>fighters[1].hp?fighters[0]:fighters[1]);}
}
function drawStage(index){const spec=roster[index%12]||roster[0],bg=img('stage-'+spec.id);if(bg)ctx.drawImage(bg,0,0,W,H);else rect(0,0,W,H,'#231037');
 const flick=(Math.sin(clock*10)*.5+Math.sin(clock*17)*.4+1)*7;
 for(const x of [408,640,876]){let g=ctx.createRadialGradient(x,323,1,x,323,65+flick);g.addColorStop(0,'#ffc75b44');g.addColorStop(1,'#fa7a0000');ctx.fillStyle=g;ctx.beginPath();ctx.arc(x,323,65+flick,0,Math.PI*2);ctx.fill();}
}
function drawFighter(f){let id=f.spec.id,idx=0,deep=f.spec.deep;
 if(f.knock>0){idx=f.knockElapsed<.14?13:f.knockElapsed<.32?14:15;}
 else if(f.stun>0)idx=Math.floor(clock*12)%2?12:13;
 else if(f.atk){const t=cap(f.atkTime/attacks[f.atk].dur,0,.999);
  const low=attacks[f.atk].height==='low',air=attacks[f.atk].height==='air';
  // Ishtar's low striking style and Gula's upright counter-striking style use distinct sprite sequences.
  const frames=low?(id==='ishtar'?[14,15,15,14]:[15,14,15,14]):
    air?(id==='gula'?[4,8,10,11]:[4,9,10,11]):
    f.atk==='palm'?(id==='gula'?[12,13,12,13]:[12,13,13,12]):
    f.atk==='kick'?(id==='gula'?[9,10,11,8]:[8,9,10,11]):
    f.atk==='heavy'?(id==='gula'?[10,11,8,9]:[8,9,10,11]):
    id==='gula'?[13,9,11,12,13]:[12,9,10,11,12];
  idx=frames[Math.min(frames.length-1,Math.floor(t*frames.length))];
 }else if(f.anim==='jump')idx=0; // upright airborne pose, never reuse knee-up kick frames for jumping
 else if(f.anim==='walk')idx=4+Math.floor(f.walkTimer%4);
 else if(f.crouch)idx=15;
 else if(f.guard)idx=12;
 else idx=0; // stationary guard: breathing ONLY, no stepping cycle.
 const picture=img(id+'-'+idx);if(!picture)return;
 ctx.save();ctx.translate(Math.round(f.x),Math.round(GROUND+f.y));ctx.scale(f.side,1);
 ctx.fillStyle='#13071290';ctx.beginPath();ctx.ellipse(0,10,74+Math.min(24,f.y*.1),13,0,0,Math.PI*2);ctx.fill();
 // The origin/feet stay planted. Only subtle upper-body breathing appears when idle.

 const breath=resting?1+Math.sin(clock*2.1+f.breathSeed)*.0037:1;

 ctx.imageSmoothingEnabled=true;ctx.drawImage(picture,-265,-418,530,426);
 // Impact VFX follow strike height. Ishtar's attacks are always LOW and crouched.
 if(f.atk&&f.atkHit){const m=attacks[f.atk],p=Math.max(0,1-(f.atkTime-m.wind)/.3);if(p>0){const y=m.height==='low'?-85:m.height==='air'?-205:-184;
 ctx.globalAlpha=p*.85;ctx.strokeStyle=f.atk==='power2'?'#fff2bb':f.spec.accent;ctx.lineWidth=f.atk.startsWith('power')?13:7;ctx.beginPath();ctx.ellipse(m.range*.46,y,m.range*.42,23,0,-.8,1.5);ctx.stroke();ctx.globalAlpha=1;}}
 ctx.restore();}
function hud(){rect(0,0,W,120,'#170b20ec');const p=fighters[0],q=fighters[1];text(p.spec.name,34,28,29,'#fce0a5','left');text(q.spec.name,W-34,28,29,'#fce0a5','right');
 const bw=454;rect(34,59,bw,22,'#382b40',6);rect(W-34-bw,59,bw,22,'#382b40',6);
 rect(34,59,bw*(p.hp/1000),22,p.hp<300?'#d14c59':'#e7bd63',6);rect(W-34-bw+bw*(1-q.hp/1000),59,bw*(q.hp/1000),22,q.hp<300?'#d14c59':'#80b5dc',6);
 text(String(Math.ceil(roundTime)),W/2,59,50,'#fff1ca');text('◆ '+runGold.toLocaleString()+' GOLD',W/2,108,20,'#ffde85');
 if(modeIndex===MODE_ARCADE)text(`MATCH ${round} / 12`,W/2,145,18,'#ffedb6');
 rect(0,H-54,W,54,'#160d21df');text('MOVE: STICK  ·  DOWN + X/B/Y: LOW ATTACKS  ·  A: JUMP  ·  AIR X/B/Y: AIR ATTACKS  ·  LB/RB: POWERS  ·  LT: GUARD',W/2,H-28,16,'#f8dca3');
}
function drawEffects(){for(const e of effects){const r=e.r*(1.5-e.t/e.max);ctx.globalAlpha=e.t/e.max;ctx.strokeStyle=e.color;ctx.lineWidth=9*e.t/e.max+2;ctx.beginPath();ctx.arc(e.x,e.y,r,0,Math.PI*2);ctx.stroke();ctx.globalAlpha=1;}
 for(const e of callouts){ctx.globalAlpha=cap(e.t/Math.min(e.max,.45),0,1);text(e.txt,e.x,e.y,24,e.color);ctx.globalAlpha=1;}}
function drawBackdrop(){const bg=img('stage-ishtar');if(bg)ctx.drawImage(bg,0,0,W,H);else rect(0,0,W,H,'#1c1029');rect(0,0,W,H,'#08020bc7');}
function title(){drawBackdrop();text('THRONES OF AKKAD',W/2,139,72,'#ffe4a0');text('TWELVE GODDESSES  ·  FOUR THRONES  ·  ONE TOURNAMENT',W/2,207,26,'#f5d69a');
 for(let i=0;i<12;i++){const x=214+(i%6)*148,y=285+Math.floor(i/6)*177;const pic=img('card-'+roster[i].id);if(pic)ctx.drawImage(pic,x,y,123,118);}
 text('ALL TWELVE SELECTABLE · SHARED MOVE SYSTEM',W/2,625,17,'#ecd0b4');text('ENTER / SPACE OR GAMEPAD A: CHARACTER SELECT',W/2,655,23,'#ffde9b');text(noPad,W/2,692,14,pads.length?'#baf8cb':'#ffaeae');}
function rosterScreen(){drawBackdrop();text('CHOOSE YOUR GODDESS',W/2,51,51,'#ffe0a2');text('LB / RB  CHANGE MODE: '+modes[modeIndex],W/2,107,23,'#e8cc9c');
 for(let i=0;i<12;i++){const x=148+(i%4)*253,y=151+Math.floor(i/4)*152,chosen=(selectionPhase===1?cursor:p2cursor)===i;
  rect(x-7,y-7,222,137,chosen?'#f1c76c':'#6d5239',9);const pic=img('card-'+roster[i].id);if(pic)ctx.drawImage(pic,x,y,208,123);
  if(chosen){ctx.strokeStyle='#fff0b0';ctx.lineWidth=3;ctx.strokeRect(x-9,y-9,227,140);}
 }
 text(selectionPhase===1?'PLAYER 1 · PRESS A TO SELECT':'PLAYER 2 / CPU RIVAL · PRESS A TO SELECT',W/2,637,24,'#ffe5ab');
 text(selectionPhase===2&&modeIndex===MODE_VS_P2?'SECOND CONTROLLER SELECTS':'D-PAD / ARROWS: SELECT  ·  ENTER: CONFIRM  ·  ESC: BACK  ·  NO KEYBOARD FIGHTING',W/2,682,15,'#eee0ca');
 if(callouts.length)drawEffects();}
function centerOverlay(head,sub,detail){rect(0,0,W,H,'#0d0613be');text(head,W/2,245,64,'#ffdf99');text(sub,W/2,340,30,'#eed3a5');text(detail,W/2,457,24,'#fff5d3');}
function draw(){if(screen==='title'){title();return;}if(screen==='roster'){rosterScreen();return;}
 drawStage(activeStage);if(fighters.length){drawFighter(fighters[0]);drawFighter(fighters[1]);hud();drawEffects();}
 if(pause)centerOverlay('PAUSED','START TO CONTINUE','CONTROLLER ONLY');
 if(screen==='result')centerOverlay(result,'◆ '+runGold.toLocaleString()+' GOLD','PRESS A TO REMATCH   ·   PRESS X FOR ROSTER');
 if(screen==='intermission')centerOverlay('VICTORY · MATCH '+round+' / 12','◆ '+runGold.toLocaleString()+' GOLD',round===12?'PRESS A TO SEE TOURNAMENT RESULT':'PRESS A FOR NEXT OPPONENT');
 if(screen==='complete')centerOverlay('TOURNAMENT COMPLETE','ALL TWELVE MATCHES CLEARED','PRESS A TO RETURN TO THE ROSTER');
}
// Mouse/touch spectator controls. Optional: gamepads retain their original control scheme.
// Menu-only keyboard access. No keyboard movement, combat, jump or guard mappings.
document.addEventListener('keydown',event=>{
 const target=event.target;
 if(target&&(/^(INPUT|TEXTAREA|SELECT|BUTTON)$/.test(target.tagName)||target.isContentEditable))return;
 const key=event.key;
 if(screen==='title'&&(key==='Enter'||key===' ')){
  event.preventDefault();screen='roster';selectionPhase=1;modeIndex=MODE_WATCH;sound(400,.09);return;
 }
 if(screen==='roster'){
  let used=true;
  if(key==='ArrowLeft')selectionPhase===1?cursor=(cursor+11)%12:p2cursor=(p2cursor+11)%12;
  else if(key==='ArrowRight')selectionPhase===1?cursor=(cursor+1)%12:p2cursor=(p2cursor+1)%12;
  else if(key==='ArrowUp')selectionPhase===1?cursor=(cursor+8)%12:p2cursor=(p2cursor+8)%12;
  else if(key==='ArrowDown')selectionPhase===1?cursor=(cursor+4)%12:p2cursor=(p2cursor+4)%12;
  else if(key==='Enter'||key===' '){
   if(modeIndex!==MODE_WATCH)modeIndex=MODE_WATCH;
   if(selectionPhase===1){selectionPhase=2;p2cursor=p2cursor===cursor?(cursor+1)%12:p2cursor;}
   else {round=1;runGold=0;startMatch();}
  }else if(key==='Escape'||key==='Backspace'){
   if(selectionPhase===2)selectionPhase=1;else screen='title';
  }else used=false;
  if(used)event.preventDefault();
  return;
 }
 if((key==='Escape'||key==='Backspace')&&screen!=='title'){
  event.preventDefault();pause=false;screen='roster';modeIndex=MODE_WATCH;selectionPhase=1;
 }
});
const spectator=document.createElement('section');
spectator.id='akkad-spectator-controls';
spectator.setAttribute('aria-label','CPU versus CPU spectator controls');
spectator.style.cssText='position:fixed;z-index:9999;right:12px;bottom:12px;width:min(350px,calc(100vw - 24px));padding:14px;border:2px solid #d3a75c;border-radius:12px;background:#170d25f5;color:#ffdfab;box-shadow:0 8px 32px #000b;font:14px system-ui,sans-serif;text-align:left';
const heading=document.createElement('div');
heading.textContent='WATCH CPU VS CPU · NO CONTROLLER';
heading.style.cssText='font-weight:800;letter-spacing:.06em;margin-bottom:9px';
spectator.append(heading);
const selectMenu=document.createElement('button');
selectMenu.type='button';selectMenu.textContent='OPEN CHARACTER SELECT';
selectMenu.style.cssText='width:100%;padding:10px;margin:0 0 10px;background:#442b59;color:#ffdfab;border:1px solid #e5be7d;border-radius:6px;cursor:pointer;font-weight:800';
selectMenu.addEventListener('click',()=>{pause=false;screen='roster';modeIndex=MODE_WATCH;selectionPhase=1;});
spectator.append(selectMenu);
const pickers=document.createElement('div');
pickers.style.cssText='display:flex;gap:8px;margin-bottom:9px';
function makePicker(labelText,selected){
 const wrap=document.createElement('label');
 wrap.style.cssText='flex:1;min-width:0;font-size:12px;display:grid;gap:4px';
 const label=document.createElement('span');label.textContent=labelText;
 const select=document.createElement('select');
 select.style.cssText='width:100%;padding:9px 5px;background:#fff3df;color:#20132d;border-radius:5px;border:0;font:600 13px system-ui';
 roster.forEach((g,i)=>{const op=document.createElement('option');op.value=String(i);op.textContent=g.name;select.append(op);});
 select.value=String(selected);wrap.append(label,select);pickers.append(wrap);return select;
}
const cpuOne=makePicker('LEFT FIGHTER',0),cpuTwo=makePicker('RIGHT FIGHTER',1);
spectator.append(pickers);
const actions=document.createElement('div');
actions.style.cssText='display:flex;gap:8px';
function makeAction(label,primary,callback){
 const btn=document.createElement('button');btn.type='button';btn.textContent=label;
 btn.style.cssText='flex:1;padding:12px 9px;border-radius:6px;border:1px solid #e5be7d;cursor:pointer;font:800 13px system-ui;background:'+(primary?'#e7b962':'#31203f')+';color:'+(primary?'#1a1024':'#ffe5b9');
 btn.addEventListener('click',callback);actions.append(btn);return btn;
}
makeAction('SELECT / START',true,()=>{
 cursor=Number(cpuOne.value);p2cursor=Number(cpuTwo.value);
 modeIndex=MODE_WATCH;selectionPhase=2;round=1;runGold=0;winStreak=0;
 startMatch();
});
makeAction('BACK / SELECT',false,()=>{
 pause=false;modeIndex=MODE_WATCH;selectionPhase=1;screen='roster';
});
spectator.append(actions);
const note=document.createElement('div');
note.textContent='Choose any two goddesses, then click SELECT / START. No controller required.';
note.style.cssText='font-size:11px;line-height:1.4;margin-top:8px;opacity:.85';
spectator.append(note);
document.body.append(spectator);
function frame(t){const dt=cap((t-lastTime)/1000,0,.045);lastTime=t;update(dt);draw();requestAnimationFrame(frame);}requestAnimationFrame(frame);
// Local testing helpers do not change controller-only combat.
window.__AKKAD_TEST__={state:()=>({screen,modeIndex,cursor,p2cursor,round,runGold,players:fighters.map(f=>({id:f.spec.id,x:f.x,y:f.y,hp:f.hp,anim:f.anim,combo:f.combo,knock:f.knock,attack:f.atk}))}),forceMatch:(id=0,mode=1)=>{cursor=id;modeIndex=mode;round=1;runGold=0;startMatch();}};

</script></body></html>
